"""Repro for: Q(a__rel__in=qs) | Q(a__rel__count=0) -> ProgrammingError (subquery must return only one column).

Mirrors the issue using tests/queries models:
  - FK-then-reverse-FK path: Annotation.tag (FK) -> Tag.children (reverse FK to Tag)
  - M2M path: Annotation.notes (M2M)
"""
import sys
import django
from django.conf import settings

REPO = 'C:/Users/agent/work/work/django-14351-nopanel'
sys.path.insert(0, REPO + '/tests')

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={'default': {'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.sqlite3', 'NAME': ':memory:'}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=['django.contrib.contenttypes', 'django.contrib.auth', 'queries'],
    DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD='django.db.models.AutoField',
    USE_TZ=True,
)
django.setup()

from django.db.models import Count, Q
from django.db.utils import ProgrammingError
from django.test.utils import setup_test_environment

setup_test_environment()
from django.test.runner import DiscoverRunner
runner = DiscoverRunner(interactive=False, verbosity=0)
runner.setup_databases()

from queries.models import Annotation, Tag, Note

tag = Tag.objects.create(name='t1')
note1 = Note.objects.create(note='n1', misc='m1')
note2 = Note.objects.create(note='n2', misc='m2')
ann = Annotation.objects.create(name='a1', tag=tag)
ann.notes.add(note1)

print('=' * 30, 'shape A: FK -> reverse FK (tag__children)', '=' * 30)
rel_qs = Tag.objects.all()
qs = Annotation.objects.annotate(Count('tag__children'))

sql_working = str(qs.filter(
    Q(tag__children__id__in=rel_qs.values_list('id', flat=True)) | Q(tag__children__count=0)
).distinct().query)
print('WOROWNER (id__in) SQL:\n', sql_working, '\n')
try:
    n = qs.filter(
        Q(tag__children__id__in=rel_qs.values_list('id', flat=True)) | Q(tag__children__count=0)
    ).distinct().count()
    print('WOROWNER count():', n)
except ProgrammingError as e:
    print('WOROWNER count() FAILED:', e)

sql_broken = str(qs.filter(
    Q(tag__children__in=rel_qs) | Q(tag__children__count=0)
).distinct().query)
print('\nBROKEN (in) SQL:\n', sql_broken, '\n')
try:
    n = qs.filter(
        Q(tag__children__in=rel_qs) | Q(tag__children__count=0)
    ).distinct().count()
    print('BROKEN count():', n)
except ProgrammingError as e:
    print('BROKEN count() FAILED:', e)

print()
print('=' * 30, 'shape B: M2M (notes)', '=' * 30)
qs2 = Annotation.objects.annotate(Count('notes'))
try:
    n = qs2.filter(Q(notes__in=Note.objects.all()) | Q(notes__count=0)).distinct().count()
    print('M2M BROKEN count():', n)
except ProgrammingError as e:
    print('M2M BROKEN count() FAILED:', e)

print()
print('=' * 30, 'control: same filters without OR / without annotate', '=' * 30)
try:
    n = Annotation.objects.filter(Q(tag__children__in=rel_qs) | Q(tag__children__count=0)).distinct().count()
    print('no-annotate OR count():', n)
except ProgrammingError as e:
    print('no-annotate OR count() FAILED:', e)
try:
    n = Annotation.objects.annotate(Count('tag__children')).filter(tag__children__in=rel_qs).distinct().count()
    print('annotate, no-OR count():', n)
except ProgrammingError as e:
    print('annotate, no-OR count() FAILED:', e)
